digest.en: Asia-Pacific leads the board this hour with Nepal flood survivors return to ruins to salvage memories. 24 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर यूरोप और रूस की अगुवाई है, अंतरिक्ष में नासा ने भेजी नई 'आंख', हजारों एलियन ग्रह खोजेगा रोमन, डार्क मैटर का भी खोलेगा राज मुख्य खबर है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Nepal flood survivors return to ruins to salvage memories
articles.summary: The village of Dhunge, once home to roughly 150 families, now lies in ruins, reduced to a swampy expanse with an ominous rotting stench. one of dozens of settlements obliterated by the Himalayan floods. Nepal flood survivors return to ruins to salvage memories.

articles.title: Bangladesh’s J-10CE fighter plan stirs China dependence fears
articles.summary: Bangladesh’s planned J-10CE purchase could significantly strengthen its airpower while tying that capability more closely to Chinese weapons, support networks and supply chains. This month, multiple media outlets reported that Bangladesh is moving toward one of its largest defense procurements in years, preparing to buy Chinese J-10CE fighter jets as part of an air force [] The post Bangladesh’s Bangladesh’s J-10CE fighter plan stirs China dependence fears.

articles.title: Zelenskyy Blasts 'Negligence' As Ukraine Mourns Dozens Killed In Russian Strike
articles.summary: Ukrainian rescue crews early on August 30 continued to search for victims of the deadly Russian attack outside of Kyiv, while local residents -- as well as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy -- demanded answers as to why explosives were stored in a warehouse so near private housing. Zelenskyy Blasts 'Negligence' As Ukraine Mourns Dozens Killed In Russian Strike.

articles.title: Was it a mistake for 99 Colombian guerrillas to lay down their arms?
articles.summary: ‘Total peace’ plan of previous government led only 99 of Colombia’s 30,000 armed combatants to disarm, but new president Abelardo De la Espriella opposes peace agreementsIn mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia where they lined up and, one by one, handed their weapons to government officials: rifles, pistols, machine gun.

articles.title: The geopolitical imperative for a self-reliant South Korea
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump’s abrupt directive on August 16, 2026, to drastically scale back the joint “Ulchi Freedom Shield” (UFS) military exercises sent shockwaves across the Asia-Pacific geostrategic landscape. The unilateral announcement, posted to social media mere hours before the large-scale maneuvers involving 18,000 South Korean troops were set to launch, was justified by Washington [] Th The geopolitical imperative for a self-reliant South Korea.

articles.title: Bangladesh should join the Mecca pact – if the bargain’s real
articles.summary: Bangladesh’s problem is not its geography. It is a geopolitical imagination too often confined by geography. So long as Dhaka views its foreign policy almost exclusively through the South Asian frame, India will remain the dominant power around which every Bangladeshi calculation revolves. articles.title: Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages
articles.summary: An "all-Russian" MC-21 passenger jet made its first test flight in early August, marking a step closer to full production, due to begin in 2027. But years of geopolitical turbulence have pushed the project far off-course, aviation insiders say. Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages.

articles.title: Who counts as ‘foreign’ in Indonesia’s deepening China ties?
articles.summary: When China’s Defense Minister Admiral Dong Jun visited Jakarta on August 21, he and Indonesia’s Defense Minister Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin agreed to deepen military cooperation. At a joint press conference, Dong said Indonesia and China would work together against the “malicious intentions” of foreign powers. The two countries also agreed to expand defense cooperation. articles.title: Trump Dismisses Fears Of Russian Strike On NATO: 'I Am Not Concerned'
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump told reporters that he does not believe Moscow will attack a NATO nation amid rising concerns that Russian President Vladimir Putin will strike a Baltic country or other member state to test the Western alliance’s resolve. Trump Dismisses Fears of Russian Strike On NATO After CIA Chief Visits Moscow. Trump Dismisses Fears Of Russian Strike On NATO: 'I Am Not Concerned'.

articles.title: Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village
articles.summary: After a Ukrainian drone operator spotted an SOS sign outside a destroyed home in the Donetsk region, a three-day rescue mission was launched to save a couple who were the last remaining residents of their frontline village. Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village.

articles.title: Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says
articles.summary: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL). UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues. Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says.

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: Tracking Syria’s transition
articles.summary: As Damascus continues to rebuild after more than a decade of war – from the recent dissolution of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces to the United States’ removal of Syria from its sponsors of terrorism list – a top UN official warned the Security Council on Thursday that international support can help tackle outstanding challenges. UN News app users can follow here.

articles.title: Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster
articles.summary: Amid reports that hundreds of people are still missing in Nepal and China after a floodwater surge slammed into towns and villages on Wednesday, aid teams have been working to reach communities cut off by the disaster. Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster.

articles.title: Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire
articles.summary: A July roadmap sponsored by the Board of Peace has failed to overcome obstacles that have mired Gaza’s ceasefire deal ten months on. A mix of sustained pressure and diplomatic guarantees is needed to break the logjam and centre Palestinian agency in the strip's recovery. Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire.

articles.title: Curbing Reprisals in Syria
articles.summary: Fuelled by wartime grievances, mob attacks and other forms of retribution threaten Syria’s transition. Damascus has done too little to deter such acts. It should ensure visible legal consequences for violence and broaden locally rooted policing to rebuild trust among vulnerable communities. Curbing Reprisals in Syria.

articles.title: On Our Radar
articles.summary: scans conflicts and crises around the globe every week and features some of the hotspots Crisis Group’s analysts are closely watching. Whether an under-reported trend or a headline-grabbing development, our field experts explain why it matters or what should be done. On Our Radar.

articles.title: Assessing the New U.S. Initiative for Libya
articles.summary: Washington is negotiating an accord that would piece Libya’s divided national institutions back together. But its political aspects have sown fierce controversy. Rather than risk the country’s tenuous peace, U. S. mediators should seek broader buy-in, focusing on budgetary and military issues in the interim. Assessing the New U. Initiative for Libya.

Nepal Thanks India For Help: तिब्बत में ग्लेशियर टूटने के बाद नेपाल में जो बाढ़ आई, उसने खुद इस हिमालयी देश समेत पूरी दुनिया को दंग कर दिया. ऐसे में पड़ोसी धर्म निभाते हुए सबसे पहले भारत ने मदद का हाथ आगे बढ़ाते हुए नेपाल को हर वो मदद दी, जिसकी उसे इन हालात में जरूरत थी.

articles.summary: PoJK Violence: पाकिस्तान के कब्जे वाले जम्मू-कश्मीर (PoJK) में हालिया अशांति को लेकर पाकिस्तान के मानवाधिकार आयोग (HRCP) ने गंभीर चिंता जताई है। HRCP के मुताबिक, क्षेत्र में बढ़ता संस्थागत अविश्वास, अभिव्यक्ति और संचार की आजादी पर प्रतिबंध के अलावा प्रदर्शनकारियों के खिलाफ राज्य की सख्त कार्रवाई ने हालात को और तनावपूर्ण बनाया है। आयोग ने कहा कि कथित तौर पर जरूरत से ज्यादा बल के इस्तेमाल ने भी स्थि।

articles.summary: Nepal foreign minister Shishir Khanal: नेपाल में आई भीषण बाढ़ में मरने वालों का आंकड़ा 700 पार पहुंच गया है। राहत व बचाव कार्य जारी है। अब तक 4,000 से अधिक लोगों को सुरक्षित निकाला जा चुका है, जिनमें 200 से ज्यादा विदेशी नागरिक भी शामिल हैं। वहीं, 2 हजार से अधिक लोग लापता हैं। नेपाल को दुनिया भर से मदद भी मिल रही है। भारत ने अब तक 70 टन से अधिक राहत सामग्री पहुंचाई है।

articles.summary: Nepal Flood Update: नेपाल में कुदरत का एक ऐसा कहर देखने को मिला है जिसने हंसते-खेलते गांवों को मिनटों में मलबे के ढेर में बदल दिया। त्रिशूली नदी में आई अचानक बाढ़ ने ऐसी तबाही मचाई कि न सड़कें बचीं, न मकान और न ही लोगों के आशियाने। नदी के उफान में पूरा का पूरा गांव समा गया है। जो लोग जिंदा बचे हैं, वे अब बदहवास होकर कीचड़ और मलबे के बीच अपने परिजनों को तलाश रहे हैं।
